contract: Vendor names that a prompt may plausibly attach to one of this project's MPNs. A vendor-looking qualifier that does not match the resolved line's own manufacturer fails routing closed instead of silently answering about a same-name part from another vendor. Listing a name that is also a project manufacturer is harmless; omitting a plausible one is the risk, so extend this list whenever a new second-source vendor becomes plausible for a BOM line.
